title: The other player sees only that a prompt is open
notes: R81, §10.6: a prompt's promptOpened and promptAnswered events reach the other seat as their player alone; the kind and the choice id stay the holder's. Only the views change: no state, event or legal action does, so every game's view hashes move and the classifier reads it as a rule every game meets.

player.title: Your choices stay private
fixes: While you make a choice, your opponent sees only that you are choosing, not what kind of choice it is.
